observations.input: Ten published disk-integrated flux-density measurements from ALMA Partnership et al. 2015; about 60 percent of rotation. Not a new 2026 image or independent reduction.

modelAssumptions.uniformity: Uniform albedo and thermal properties; one layer without vertical thermal/dielectric-property gradients.
modelAssumptions.shape: Viikinkoski et al. 2015 DAMIT triangular plate shape and pole adopted by authors, not independently registered here.
modelAssumptions.code: KRC thermophysical calculation plus radiative transfer; not rerun.
modelAssumptions.scaleCaution: Publisher inputs, not new skyGeometry or raster calculations, not current ephemeris.

reportedResults.statisticalMeaning: Weighted averages and weighted standard deviations over 19 acceptable models; authors explicitly say not necessarily statistical confidence levels. Equivalent emissivity weakly constrained.
reportedResults.effectiveEmissivityDistinct: 0.88 ± 0.05 at 1.3 mm, calculated with assumed smooth bolometric emissivity 0.95; not the fitted equivalent emissivity or visible albedo.
reportedResults.porosity: About 45 percent inferred through laboratory dielectric relationships, versus much larger porosity required by ordinary-chondrite thermal-contact models. Not a direct local measurement.
reportedResults.grainAndRepulsion: Tens-of-micrometre grain interpretation and repulsive reduction of contact proposed to reconcile models, not detected grain sizes, electrostatic field or observed mechanism.
reportedResults.geography: Disk-integrated model cannot uniquely distinguish topography, roughness and thermal/dielectric variation; no local chemistry, calibrated visible colour or registered terrain.

literalManuscriptDifferences.finding: Section 2 states four equivalent emissivity values 0.7–1.0, but Table A1 includes 0.6 rows (reduced chi-squared 2.23 and 2.58).
literalManuscriptDifferences.disposition: Preserve literal discrepancy; cause and version-of-record comparison open; no table repair.

literalManuscriptDifferences.finding: Section 2 prose suggests thermal inertia below 25 tiu, while conclusion accepts 5–40 tiu and Table A1 includes two 40-tiu rows.
literalManuscriptDifferences.disposition: Keep alternatives; not a revised upper limit or catalogue update.

literalManuscriptDifferences.finding: Caption says a few emissivity-1 solutions are not included; table retains four emissivity-1 rows with empty roughness cells.
literalManuscriptDifferences.disposition: Wording/omission referent unresolved; preserve blank cells, do not remove rows or infer zero roughness.
